messages:
Maya Singh: Hi! first day here — trying to run `kubectl get pods -n maya-sandbox` after following the quickstart but i get "error: current-context is not set". Any tips?
onboard-bot: Welcome Maya! Please open the Kube onboarding form if you haven't: https://go.redwood.internal/onboard-kube. Include the namespace you need.
devex: hey maya - quick checks: `echo $KUBECONFIG`, `kubectl config get-contexts --no-headers || true`, and whether you ran the `redwood-cli onboard kube` helper. Macs sometimes have multiple KUBECONFIG entries separated by `:` which can hide contexts.
Maya Singh: echo $KUBECONFIG -> /Users/maya/.kube/config:/tmp/rw-kube
kubectl config get-contexts -> (no output)
eng-infra: thanks. looks like the merge didn't include org contexts. We'll create a service-account kubeconfig for `maya-sandbox` with `edit` role. Please DM your work email and confirm you need port-forward rights. ETA ~20m after you submit the request.
onboard-bot: Request created: KUBE-REQ-2417 (https://go.redwood.internal/requests/KUBE-REQ-2417)
eng-infra: done - uploaded SA kubeconfig to Vault: https://vault.redwood/internal/kubeconfigs/KUBE-REQ-2417. Export with `export KUBECONFIG=/tmp/maya-kube` then `kubectl get pods -n maya-sandbox`. If you need longer expiry ask on this thread.
Maya Singh: verified - pods listed and port-forward works. thanks everyone!
